state.purpose: Mutate the stable low-friction cluster into higher-value offers. Optimize for highest realized owner hourly earnings reached as quickly as possible.

world.priorEvidenceMode: structural A/B findings only; no prior Noul values included as authority
stableFindings: Procurement-renewal and cloud-cost candidates consistently form the low-friction cluster.
M&A screening has a stronger per-output value ceiling but slower time-to-cash.
AI profitability gate had no stable dominant advantage in its prior form.
marketEvidence: Zylo reports procurement customers using renewal and usage intelligence to generate measurable software savings, including large realized savings cases.
Vertice sells SaaS renewal visibility, benchmarking and savings outcomes and states it uses a large vendor pricing database.
Tropic markets contract extraction, renewal timing and spend intelligence backed by large negotiation/spend datasets and reports customer savings.
Vantage reports broad adoption for cloud/AI spend visibility and cost reduction; customer cases include quantified monthly/cloud savings.
world.evidenceCaveat: Vendor adoption and savings claims are vendor-reported; they prove category demand, not this exact entrant.

candidates.name: software-renewal-savings-watch
candidates.claim: Finance/procurement uploads a fixed renewal calendar plus contract, quote and available usage facts. The engine continuously prioritizes upcoming software/AI renewals and returns standardized cancel, downgrade, consolidate, re-quote, renew, or investigate actions with evidence. Customer executes every action and returns final annualized spend/savings. Start with one paid renewal analysis, then prepaid monthly monitoring. No negotiation service, proprietary benchmark promise, or standard owner review.

candidates.name: cloud-cost-savings-watch
candidates.claim: A cloud/AI-using company provides recurring read-only billing exports. The engine detects cost anomalies, idle/waste patterns, concentration and quantified savings opportunities, then returns a prioritized action list. Customer executes changes and returns realized savings. Start with one paid snapshot, then prepaid monthly monitoring. No infrastructure changes or standard owner review.

candidates.name: tech-spend-opportunity-gate
candidates.claim: Finance provides a fixed monthly export of software renewals, AI/provider spend and cloud billing summaries. The engine returns only the top evidence-backed cost actions across cancel, downgrade, consolidate, re-quote, optimize, or investigate, ranked by expected annualized savings. Customer executes all effects and returns realized savings. Start with one paid snapshot, then recurring monitoring. No full spend-management platform, no proprietary benchmark promise, no standard owner review.

candidates.name: outcome-priced-renewal-watch
candidates.claim: Same standardized software-renewal workflow as T1, but commercial terms are a small prepaid base fee plus a share of verified first-year savings from customer-executed actions. Realized savings readback is mandatory. No negotiation execution, no proprietary benchmark promise, and no standard owner review.

constraints: No full platform build before paid evidence.
First paid test uses exported files where possible.
No proprietary pricing benchmark is claimed unless actually acquired.
